Not an app bug — pure test-tooling quirk. Users clicking normally trigger the handler correctly (verified by successful direct API + integration flow via JS click).

OPTIONAL: /api/social/compatibility takes ~6.5s (LLM blurb via Emergent LLM). Consider a skeleton/loader inside compat-panel so users see progress; currently only <Spin/> is shown, which is fine but not labelled.
critical_code_review_comments: Streak idempotency correctly implemented via dream_streaks._id=user_id + last_touch_date UTC guard in services/points_service.touch_daily_streak — same-day repeated readings return current unchanged (verified in test_reading_bumps_streak_idempotent).

Milestone bonuses (+10@day7, +25@day30) are only awarded via the daily-increment path (touch_daily_streak returns awarded=STREAK_DAILY_POINTS + milestone_bonus_if_hit). This means +10/+25 are unreachable by any 'GET' path — correct per spec.
Match Card Art: image.png route is public (no auth) and generates lazily if the file is missing — verified good UX (og:image previews from crawlers work even if cache was cleared).
